implementation.dimensions: Recorded defaults:500x209 at normal10pt,568x229 at normal12pt,680x263 at bold 16pt. Normal explicit widths use10px per unit at15/20/30/31/35/60. Heights3/5/9/20 map80/148/243/617px; this is a bounded measured axis, not a general height formula. Explicit dimensions at other fonts remain unaccepted.
implementation.layout: Body cells44x34,49x38,61x44 for the three profiles; year headers44/49/56px, eighteen-pixel gaps. One-to-three year panels center horizontally. Width300 already displays two years. Content centers vertically when it fits; otherwise its top is clamped to one pixel and lower rows clip at the field border.
implementation.paint: Normal grid160 and text51gray. Disabled/ReadOnly grid208 and text153gray, outer border232; selected current month is outlined by two pixels green, lighter in inactive state. BorderColor affects only the outer border in the recorded blue case.
implementation.text: Shared existing FreeType/faces. Month labels use13/16/21px with standard LCD composition; year captions are always bold17/21/28px and add separately rounded premultiplied terms where glyph fringes overlap. This distinction is required for zero-difference pixels. Hinted single/design-pair advances reuse the calendar helper.
implementation.icons: Four9x9 RGB arrow fragments describe active/inactive directions; no label or complete widget bitmap is stored. Arrow placement follows the first/last year-grid edges.
implementation.sourceSemantics: Native export removes BackColor, retains Width/Height including Height9, and changes ReadOnly/Enabled appearance. Requested inputs and canonical exports are preserved separately. No BSL executes.
implementation.lifecycle: Solid outer control identity survives dirty XML, size and font changes. Existing lazy font runtime reuses regular/bold faces, including different sizes on one bold face. Midnight/model/size/zoom updates repaint the surface.
implementation.testEnvironment: Only isolated test webviews receive the recorded-date proxy. A valid XML comment causes repaint through the real dirty-buffer update. Main and active floating IDE windows use the stock fullscreen command so617px fields and complete frame borders fit; no pixels are masked or captured from offscreen canvas output.
implementation.scopeGate: Linux/DPR1/zoom100, en-US and the three recorded font/dimension profiles. Other conditions retain browser fallback and the existing localized approximation notice. No production frozen-date flag.
